notes_for_editor: Two names for one county: the Association calls it Piney Woods (Piney) and the Forest Lookouts page calls it Piney Woods (T), both Trinity County. They may be the same tower; not confirmed. The Trinity County pages give no agency, design, station description, staffing or fire history, so none is stated. The Cavallerano book (2025) is the likely source for these towers but was not read; the Duke University Press review returned HTTP 403.
